title: Aegis evidence pack manifest (aegis-evidence-pack-v1)
description: manifest.json of a pack written by `fleet.py export-evidence POLICY NAME` (gateway/aegisd/fleet.py export_evidence). Aegis 1.2 signs it: manifest.cose beside it is a COSE_Sign1 by the verifier key, typ application/vnd.aegis.evidence-pack+cbor, over {1: format, 2: endpoint, 3: exported, 4: SHA-256 of manifest.json as written, 5: SHA-256 of attestation-result.cbor} (common/evidence_pack.py). Every key is always written; signed_manifest since 1.2. docs/data-formats.md, docs/evidence-format.md.
$comment: Aegis 1.2 as written. A pack of Aegis 1.1 has no signed_manifest and no manifest.cose, and its result summary only status, admitted, iat and exp: it also matches this schema.

exported.description: Unix time of the export on the verifier's clock; signed in manifest.cose (claim 3) since Aegis 1.2

evidence_format.description: eat-cose-v1: evidence.cbor (EAT in COSE_Sign1, ML-DSA-65); aegis-quote-v1: evidence.token + evidence.sig (the older PQCHAL quote); psa-token: evidence.token alone (kind psa, ES256); null: the entry was refused by the policy rules before a format was chosen

policy_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the policy JSON the result was reached under (for a signed policy: of the JSON inside it)

policy_id.description: RFC 6920 ni URI of policy_sha256 (base64url, no padding), as the result's 1003 names it; null if the policy in use at export time is another one than the result's

policy_now_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the policy in use when the pack was exported; the hash of policy.json if the pack has one

result.description: copied from the signed attestation result after its signature was checked; the four Aegis 1.2 keys only where the result has the claim

audit_head.description: the result's aegis.audit-log, -batch and -head in hex

key_thumbprints.description: COSE Key Thumbprint (RFC 9679, SHA-256, hex) of each keys/<role>.cosekey: the key's AKP COSE_Key {1: 7, 3: -49, -1: pk} in deterministic CBOR

files.description: every other file of the pack and its SHA-256 (hex). manifest.json is not listed.

signed_manifest.description: Aegis 1.2: the file that signs this manifest's bytes and the export time; absent in a pack of Aegis 1.1

kind.description: the policy entry's kind (psa when the entry names none). An entry of another kind is refused at the policy stage and gets no evidence.

audit_head.description: the verifier's audit log as it stood when the result was signed: its last batch record on disk

sha256.description: SHA-256 of that batch record (the whole COSE_Sign1)

status.description: AR4SI tier of the attestation result: 2, 32, 96, 127
